title: Gate 7, dcp-jcs-v1 side: a defect of each unit class in a dcp-jcs-v1 bundle keeps today's verdict
status: Experimental evidence for docs/proposals/canonicalization-candidate/README.md §9 gate 7. Not normative; activates nothing.

how_to_read.bases: The frozen bases of phase3-signed-vectors.json, by reference: their bytes are that file's input_json, checked by hash. No new signing.
how_to_read.mutations: The same 18 byte-level edits on both bases. Edits apply in order: prefix, prefix_hex, append, append_hex, drop_last, replace_once (the text occurs exactly once) with with or with_hex.
how_to_read.cases: 36 mutated cases and 2 controls, each with an expectation for each of the 10 configurations. Expectations are reasoned from the parsers and verifiers (each shape's why), never generated from an output.
how_to_read.expected.route: The experimental route (§16): v1_path with profile_source, warning_classes and historical (decoded or failed), or reject with class and offset (relative to the unit).
how_to_read.expected.today: Today's route of the same implementation, coded directly: verified_result (the verifier returned a result); host_decode_error (the host decoder before any verifier refused; kind is its exception type or serde category); in_band_parse_error (a verifier or binding that parses itself returned a parse failure in strict form, kept whole: Go and the WASM binding; kind is its message prefix).
how_to_read.expected.verification: null when no verifier ran on the experimental route; otherwise the name of a shared shape in verification_shapes, pinning verified, errors_contain (substrings), error_count, warnings (null: the key is absent) and the stable fields (null: absent). Equality between the two routes covers every declared field of the implementation, not only these.
how_to_read.boundary: Envelope cases outside the 38 and outside any equivalence claim: G7E-1 must verify; G7E-2 and G7E-3 must not enter a verifier.
how_to_read.trust: A verified bundle grants no trust or admission and authorizes nothing.

errors_contain: JSON parse error: unexpected end of hex escape
wasm.in_band_surrogate.why: The binding's serde_json::from_str (serde_json 1.0.149, read.rs parse_unicode_escape) refuses a leading surrogate \ud800 that is not followed by a backslash with ErrorCode::UnexpectedEndOfHexEscape ("unexpected end of hex escape"); it returns only {verified:false, errors:[...]} (no warnings key). On w1, JSON.stringify writes the surrogate as an escape again. Corrected in phase B: phase A reasoned LoneLeadingSurrogateInHexEscape, which serde raises only for a trailing surrogate first or a second escape that is not a trailing surrogate; both routes returned the same text.

errors_contain: JSON parse error: recursion limit exceeded
wasm.in_band_recursion.why: The binding's serde_json::from_str stops at its recursion limit of 128 and returns only {verified:false, errors:[...]}.
